name: Visit Santa at Lorain Winterfest
paras: Santa Claus sets up his North Pole at Black River Landing, 421 Black River Lane in Lorain, during Lorain Winterfest on Saturday, November 28. He is there from 5 to 9 PM, right after the Winterfest parade.
Every child who visits receives a small gift from Santa, and families can take photos at the waterfront. Admission is free, with no tickets.
The visit is outdoors, so dress warmly, and arrive early because lines can grow as the evening goes on.
tip: Arrive early, since the line for Santa grows as the evening goes on.

name: Lorain Winterfest Holiday Parade on Broadway
paras: The Lorain Winterfest parade rolls down Broadway Avenue in downtown Lorain on Saturday, November 28, from 4:30 to 5 PM. Floats, marching bands and community groups take part, and Santa Claus rides in the parade.
Winterfest organizers advise lining up early for a good viewing spot. Free parking is available throughout downtown, and the parking garage is closed.
After the parade, families can walk to Black River Landing to meet Santa and see live reindeer, with fireworks at Veterans Park at 6 PM.
tip: Line up early along Broadway for a good view.
